js: (() => { const Q = SB.D.questions; const mk = (f) => SB.polCompute(Q.map((q) => q.bonus ? 2 : f(q))); return JSON.stringify({ toutDaccord: mk(() => 0), toutSansAvis: mk(() => 2), toutPasDuTout: mk(() => 4), gaucheFort: mk((q) => q.dir < 0 ? 0 : 4), droiteFort: mk((q) => q.dir > 0 ? 0 : 4), gauchePlutot: mk((q) => q.dir < 0 ? 1 : 3), droitePlutot: mk((q) => q.dir > 0 ? 1 : 3), ecoGaucheSocDroite: mk((q) => (q.axis === "eco" ? q.dir < 0 : q.dir > 0) ? 0 : 4) }); })()
(async () => { SB.quiz.start(); for (const q of SB.D.questions) { await FX.sleep(320); SB.quiz.answer(q.bonus ? 2 : 0); } await FX.sleep(500); return 1; })()
